data: Diário de Dev #9 — Foco em pinheirinho, ark-streams e mais 1 projetos
Relatório semanal de progresso focando nas entregas de `pinheirinho`, `ark-streams`, `clojure-lsp`. Inclui o registro completo de commits e as atividades do período.

Diário de Dev #9 — Foco em pinheirinho, ark-streams e mais 1 projetos

Período: 2026-02-26 a 2026-03-04

Este é o diário de bordo semanal registrando as entregas feitas nos repositórios pinheirinho, ark-streams, clojure-lsp.

🚀 Conquistas da Semana

Projeto: pinheirinho

  • [3a68a2a] ci: fix permissions on dist folder after docker build
  • [2e5d80d] fix: build script compatibility with python 3.3 (no f-strings)
  • [78222ae] ci: setup automated build and release with python 3.3 docker and write permissions
  • [74b1937] docs: Add comprehensive README for the Pinheirinho2 Assetto Corsa app.
  • [5f77c75] fix(sensor): add MIN_THRESHOLD floor to support small-tyre cars (Fiat 500)
  • [a22cdc5] chore: update rules logic and documentation
  • [efbdc98] feat(ui): add real-time telemetry debug panel
  • [7caf2c2] feat(sensor): implement dynamic tyre radius thresholds and burnout box lock
  • [6427bb0] fix(infra): resolve I/O race condition and staging light latching bug

Projeto: ark-streams

  • [6695deb] fix(api): register /ws/events route and sync stability/ui improvements
  • [fe9097b] feat: implement comprehensive stability and determinism suite
  • [e514e90] feat(backtest): implement JSON/Markdown report generation and equity curve tracking
  • [8147d53] refactor(pipeline): sequentialize event chain to eliminate race conditions
  • [14f5cf8] feat(protocol): introduce AnalyzedEvent for enriched telemetry

Projeto: clojure-lsp

  • [ff1b1a20] Update deps-lock.json (#2224)
  • [fb6519d9] Add dep on tools.namespace, to work around clj-depend bug (#2228)

🛠️ Tecnologias e Camadas

Nesta semana, as seguintes frentes foram trabalhadas:

  • pinheirinho: Desenvolvimento e manutenção contínua baseada no histórico de commits.
  • ark-streams: Desenvolvimento e manutenção contínua baseada no histórico de commits.
  • clojure-lsp: Desenvolvimento e manutenção contínua baseada no histórico de commits.
